payload.name: Exhaustive Location List Retrieval
payload.description: When a question asks for a list of locations/items (e.g., 'which cities does X mention visiting?'), use this skill to retrieve all distinct answers before responding.
content: When a question asks for a list of locations/items, treat it as an enumeration task: run multiple searches with alternative travel/location phrasings (traveled to, went to, visited, trip to, game/match/concert in, excited about [city]) rather than only the words from the question.

Do not require all named persons to co-occur in a memory; the target attribute belongs to the primary subject, so search primarily by that subject plus location terms, and include memories that mention the subject without the conversation partner.
Search across memory kinds (event, plan, state, preference) and do not restrict to travel-themed memories; cities can appear incidentally (e.g., 'basketball game in Seattle').

Continue searching until no new distinct locations appear or after at most three additional searches beyond the first; if the question is plural, expect multiple answers and do not stop after the first match.

solves: When a question asks for a list of locations or items (e.g., which cities a person visited or mentioned), retrieval often stops after finding one answer or over-constrains the search to all named entities, causing missing items. This skill ensures complete enumeration by running varied location-oriented searches until no new distinct items appear.
